programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: An ingredient Pati constantly uses is salt and Yucatán has one of the unique salts. The Las Coloradas salt, which means blush red, gets its distinctive color from red algae. Felipe Perez takes Pati to the pink lakes where the salt is produced.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.sub-title: A Mayan League of Their Own
programme.desc: Amazonas softball team; sweet potato and meat salpicon; pepita, egg and chaya tamales; roasted tomato and habanero salsa.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Pati arrives in Motul, a town in the history books for Yucatán's once thriving henequén industry and for the egg dish Huevos Motuleños. Pati meets Doña Evelia, who put Motul back on the map with her world-famous recipe.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Temozón is the birthplace of Yucatán's signature smoked meat Carne Ahumada and everyone in town claims to have a relative who invented it. Pati strolls around town to try different versions of Carne Ahumada.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Pati returns to Mérida to meet sisters, Delia and Maria Elide, who love to cook and laugh and are famous for recados - pastes of spices and aromatic herbs that season Yucatecan foods. In Uxmal, she learns about ingredients that make recados unique.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: No trip to Yucatán is complete without seeing a beautiful cenote, natural freshwater pools in caves. To learn more about Mayan communities, Pati visits Cenote Xocempich with lawyer Zoila Cen, who has dedicated her career to helping Mayan people.

programme.title: Europe's Greatest Train Journeys
programme.desc: The Little Yellow Train winds through the Eastern Pyrenees, crossing the Cerdan plateau, the historic Gisclard railway suspension bridge and the Grandes Canalettes caves, known as the underground Versailles of the Pyrenees.

programme.title: Europe's Greatest Train Journeys
programme.desc: In Portugal, in the Douro River Valley, a steam locomotive and a small historic train will take you in turn to the water's edge, on the only railroad line in the world that crosses three World Heritage Sites classified by UNESCO.

programme.title: Europe's Greatest Train Journeys
programme.desc: Andalusia, now crossed by high-speed and modernized rail lines, unveils its rich culture and landscapes; along the journey, we visit cities like Seville, Granada with its famed Alhambra and Guadix near the Tabernas Desert.

programme.title: Europe's Greatest Train Journeys
programme.desc: The Cinque Terre Express runs along Italy's northern coast east of Genoa; passing through five UNESCO-listed villages, it offers coastal views and access to cobbled streets, harbors, terraced vineyards and pastel-colored houses.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show
programme.sub-title: The Johnny Carson Show: Comic Legends Of The '60s - Buddy Hackett (10/16/80)
programme.desc: Buddy Hackett has knowledge on many subjects, including snakes. Dr. Morris Goldberg talks chauffeuring and Johnny addresses George Brett's hemorrhoids.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show
programme.sub-title: The Johnny Carson Show: Comic Legends Of The '60s - Joan Rivers (5/14/81)
programme.desc: The birds and the bees are a topic of conversation for Joan Rivers and Johnny notes the high price of meat these days in this episode which also features William Caulfield and Amos Caulfield.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show
programme.sub-title: The Johnny Carson Show: Comic Legends Of The '60s - Buddy Hackett (12/8/81)
programme.desc: Even Buddy Hackett bombs sometimes--just not for Johnny Carson. Rocky Graziano stops by and Johnny wonders if $2,000-worth of ornaments on a Christmas tree is too much.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show
programme.sub-title: The Johnny Carson Show: Comic Legends Of The '60s - Jack Lemmon (3/18/82)
programme.desc: Jack Lemmon can't sit through his own movies and Maureen Murphy thinks writing jokes is as hard as having a baby. Johnny has something to say about his windshield wipers.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show
programme.sub-title: The Johnny Carson Show: Comic Legends Of The '60s - Joan Rivers (10/15/82)
programme.desc: Hear what Joan Rivers has to say about retouched magazine covers, Gone With The Wind and Dolly Parton. Plus, Johnny welcomes Japanese TV personality Tetsuko Kuroyanagi.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show
programme.sub-title: The Johnny Carson Show: Comic Legends Of The '60s - Bob Newhart (5/18/83)
programme.desc: What was Bob Newhart's worst stand-up routine? He tells all in this episode which also features Anthony Quinn and Julie Lynn Hayek.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show
programme.sub-title: The Johnny Carson Show: Comic Legends Of The '60s - Bob Newhart (10/7/83)
programme.desc: Did you know Bob Newhart started his career as an accountant? We're glad he switched to comedy and visited Johnny for this episode, which also features James Stephens and Ronnie Porter.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show
programme.sub-title: The Johnny Carson Show: Comic Legends Of The '60s - Bob Newhart (10/7/83)
programme.desc: Did you know Bob Newhart started his career as an accountant? We're glad he switched to comedy and visited Johnny for this episode, which also features James Stephens and Ronnie Porter.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show
programme.sub-title: The Johnny Carson Show: Comic Legends Of The '60s - Mel Brooks (12/15/83)
programme.desc: Finally, the world has proof that Johnny's desk backdrop isn't real when Mel Brooks reveals all in this episode. Also: Teri Garr insists that money is not important to her.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show
programme.sub-title: The Johnny Carson Show: Comic Legends Of The '60s - Bob Newhart (10/9/84)
programme.desc: Bob Newhart got a Peabody, Emmy and pink slip from NBC in the same year. Johnny talks with him about it, plus Erin Gray visits the couch.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show
programme.sub-title: The Johnny Carson Show: Comic Legends Of The '60s - Don Rickles (11/21/84)
programme.desc: When Don Rickles has Thanksgiving with Bob Newhart, you want to hear him talk about it. You'll also want to hear Angie Dickinson talk about Police Woman and Johnny talk about Mr. Rogers' sweater.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show
programme.sub-title: The Johnny Carson Show: Comic Legends Of The '60s - Buddy Hackett (5/7/86)
programme.desc: This episode is a real balancing act when expert balancer Ed Kennedy graces the stage along with comic legend Buddy Hackett and Breakfast Club star Ally Sheedy.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show
programme.sub-title: The Johnny Carson Show: Comic Legends Of The '60s - Bob Newhart (9/17/86)
programme.desc: TV comedy icon Bob Newhart stops by, along with Saundra Santiago and Teresa Ganzel.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show
programme.sub-title: The Johnny Carson Show: Comic Legends Of The '60s - Jack Lemmon (11/1/89)
programme.desc: The laughs can't stop/won't stop when comedy heavyweights Jack Lemmon and Steven Wright stop by the set.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show
programme.sub-title: The Johnny Carson Show: Comic Legends Of The '60s - Don Rickles (2/7/90)
programme.desc: What do you get when you combine comedian Don Rickles, 95-year-old artist Jon Serl and a Johnny Carson monologue that mentions Pee-wee Herman and Russian Big Macs? Watch this episode to find out!

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show
programme.sub-title: The Johnny Carson Show: Comic Legends Of The '60s - Carl Reiner (8/5/85)
programme.desc: Comedy master Carl Reiner ate his way through France and now complains to Johnny about his weight gain. Shows a clip from his movie, Summer Rentals.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show
programme.sub-title: The Johnny Carson Show: Comic Legends Of The '60s - Carl Reiner (10/5/89)
programme.desc: TV's polymath Carl Reiner chats about his wife Estelle, a recent nose injury, his frequent forgetfulness, and the smash hit flick When Harry Met Sally written and directed by his son, Rob Reiner.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show
programme.sub-title: The Johnny Carson Show: Comic Legends Of The '60s - Carl Reiner (10/5/89)

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show

programme.desc: Comic genius Carl Reiner makes his 46th visit to Johnny's couch. Discusses his attempts at dieting and presents Johnny with a bunch of gifts: slippers, pipe, glasses and....a gun.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show
programme.sub-title: The Johnny Carson Show: Comic Legends Of The '70s - Steve Martin (2/15/73)
programme.desc: Wild and crazy guy Steve Martin does card tricks, George Foreman talks winning the heavyweight championship and Johnny details his valentine from Don Rickles. Sandy Duncan and Binnie Barnes also appear.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show
programme.sub-title: The Johnny Carson Show: Comic Legends Of The '70s - Rodney Dangerfield (7/3/74)
programme.desc: Johnny gives questionable amounts of respect to Rodney Dangerfield, then reasonable amounts of respect to Dom Deluise, Orson Bean and Mariette Hartley.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show
programme.sub-title: The Johnny Carson Show: Comic Legends Of The '70s - George Carlin (2/15/77)
programme.desc: George Carlin sticks only to words you CAN say on TV. Plus, Rita Reutter is an older sex symbol, McLean Stevenson had a date with the Rose Bowl Queen and Martina Navratilova is the best tennis player in the world.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show

programme.desc: Carol Burnett reveals her Hollywood idols, Tim Conway details losing his car at a party and Johnny discusses The Joy Of Sex. Plus, Robert Easton and Tracee Talavera appear.
